comment: The requirement for an explicit legal basis and consent is important, but it does not address emergency care, public-health emergencies, displaced populations, children, persons lacking capacity, or people without recognised digital identity.

anchor.note: p.78 l.Lines 947-950 read as the printed page; section 3.6.4 agrees

public.text: The requirement for an explicit legal basis and consent is important, but it does not address emergency care, public-health emergencies, displaced populations, children, persons lacking capacity, or people without recognised digital identity.
public.suggestedRevision: Add guidance for lawful exceptions, emergency access, guardianship and representation, vulnerable populations, alternative identification, minimum-necessary exchange, and post-event transparency or review.
